title: Cortege
extract:
The Cortege is an  Orokin Era weapon created by the  Entrati, a beam Archgun that builds charges on kills to allow use of the Alternate Fire, a trio of grenades that leaves lingering flames.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Heat damage on its primary fire and  Blast damage on its Alternate Fire.
Primary fire releases a flamethrower-like beam.
Pinpoint accuracy.
Consumes 0.5 ammo per tick of damage.
Beam has a thickness of ~1 meter.
Beam deals radial damage varying from of 1 to 4 meters in a cone shape.
The Atmospheric beam has innate Infinite Body Punch Through.
No Damage Falloff in Archwing Mode.
Getting 5 kills with the Cortege's primary fire will unlock an Alternate Fire that releases a trio of grenades that explodes in an 4 meter radius on impacting a surface or when remotely detonated with Alternate Fire, leaving lingering flames that deal continuous damage for 11 seconds.
Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Consumes no ammo.
After using Alternate Fire, additional kills are needed to recharge the grenade barrage.
Innate  polarity.

Acquisition
The Cortege main blueprint can be acquired by reaching Rank 3 - Clearance: Odima with the  Necraloid. The main blueprint is offered as a rank up reward, but Loid sells additional main blueprints for  8,000. Components are crafted from blueprints that can be acquired for  4,000 each after reaching Rank 2 - Clearance: Modus with the syndicate. Once crafted, it comes with a pre-installed Gravimag.
Additionally requires Rank 2 - Visitor with  Ostron in order to acquire  Fersteel Alloy required in its construction.
The Damaged Necramech Weapon parts are acquired from Normal and Arcana Isolation Vault Bounty rewards.
The Damaged Necramech Weapon parts and fully built Cortege components can be traded between players. Trading for fully built components will bypass the need for Ostron's Fersteel Alloy.

Notes
Alternate-fire charges after killing 5 enemies.
Leaves a flaming puddle dealing 1000  Heat damage per second for 11 seconds.
Puddle damage does not fall off with radius.
Puddle is not affected by faction mods.
Puddle is not affected by elemental mod bonuses.
Puddle has a fixed 68% chance [% Confirmation Needed] to proc  Heat. Procs have a shortened 3 second duration.
Proc duration is not affected by status duration mods, but is affected by  Lavos's duration passive.
Primary-fire has varying conal beam AoE along its length with radii from 1m - 4m. The 4m radius at the end of the beam is spherical, granting an effective range of 32 meters.
The initial shot briefly has the 4m radius centered on the barrel, striking enemies behind the player.
Beam AoE does not scale with multishot bonuses and is overridden by the beam itself, so only one can deal damage at a time.

Trivia
Cortège is a French term referring to processions. Its antiquated use as a loaned word in the English language though equated it with funeral processions exclusively.
During the Heart of Deimos quest, the enemy Necramech wields a Cortege during cutscenes, and at one point fires  Mausolon-like full-auto rounds. However, when fought it is armed with a Mausolon instead.
